## What's Changed
* feat(mcp): remove mcp-session-id header injection for HTTP transports by @xiaoju111a in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/681
* test: add e2e tests for wire mode by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/707
* chore: rebrand Kimi CLI to Kimi Code CLI in docs and UI copy by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/709
* docs: recommend Python 3.13 for installation by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/710
* feat(auth): add `/login` `/logout` and `kimi login | logout` by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/687
* chore(release): bump kimi-cli and kimi-code to 0.88 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/711


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.87...0.88
